description: Use when you want a long-only portfolio's risk decomposed into market, sector, subsector and residual variance, with diversification analytics and return attribution. Not for long/short books (use riskmodels_portfolio_exposure) or ETF hedge notionals (use riskmodels_analyze_portfolio). Returns, from POST /snapshot (the canonical portfolio snapshot), the L3 variance decomposition, per-position L3 hedge ratios, diversification analytics with sector and subsector ETF correlations, frozen-weight daily return attribution, cumulative return and drawdown over lookback_days, and a risk summary with dominant drivers and concentration flags. End-of-day data, refreshed after each US market close. Price: $1.25 per call.

lookback_days.description: Trading days of history for returns, attribution and the diversification window, integer 20-2000, e.g. 504 (default 252)

positions.description: Long positions, each with one of weight, dollars or shares (shares on every position or none), e.g. [{"ticker":"AAPL","weight":0.4},{"ticker":"NVDA","weight":0.35},{"ticker":"CRWD","weight":0.25}]

dollars.description: Positive position value in US dollars, used as the weight, e.g. 35000

shares.description: Share count, converted to a weight at the latest close, e.g. 120

ticker.description: US stock ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA

weight.description: Positive weight, any scale (normalized server-side), e.g. 0.35

name: riskmodels_get_portfolio_risk_snapshot
title: RiskModels Portfolio Risk Snapshot
